content.notes: Code review of module.py (candidate e9aa2342...) against the user contract. solve() raises ValueError unless data is an object containing base and patch, and unless base and patch are both objects. _merge deep-merges when both values are objects, replaces lists without concatenation, and inserts absent keys as clones. A null patch value pops the key with a default, so removing an absent key is a no-op. _json_type treats boolean and number as distinct and raises ValueError on a type mismatch, including null versus non-null. Key order follows from copying base in order and appending patch-only keys in patch order. Inputs are not mutated: base is deep-cloned up front, and patch values are cloned on insertion. Evidence: the only receipt cited is rcpt-1c8cbfb5ffcbcb5c032921b3, which was issued to the supervisor session from a run_tests call on these exact hashes (public 3/3, user tests 8/8, result pass).
